subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.wav@riff-pcm` is this plugin's own self-contained RIFF/PCM WAV audio file — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, set-fmt, set-data, set-other-chunks, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
